_doc: Shared type registry (tools/header_types.py, docs/header-canon.md 'One definition per shared type'). Each entry names the one file that defines a struct/union/typedef other TUs read: the owner TU's own header (published as include/<unit>/<tu>.h by tools/header_harvest.py) or include/shared.h. Other TUs include the owner's generated header and never restate the type; a missing member is proposed with `header_types.py propose` (header-type-proposal/1: an additive, size-preserving replacement of a padding run), reviewed, and applied by the integrator with `header_types.py apply`. `header_types.py restated` lists the types still restated by several TUs (Actor, RgGeom, ...), which need an owner decision here before their copies are removed.

the weapon database builds every weapon essence and its _ReadCommon (ov12:0x00a1cd08, ov12/tu027) fills the shared prefix: shotEssence +0x10 from the "shot" key (RgShotDBGetEssence result, sw $2,0x10 at 0x00a1d130), capacity +0x14 from "num"/"energy"/"hardness" (swc1 0x14 at 0x00a1d02c/0x00a1d048); ov12/tu026 _InitWeaponCommon copies +0x10 to weapon+0x38 (0x00a198ec/0x00a19904), which CreateRgShotFromEssence receives (0x00a1a0ec, 0x00a1b0dc)

readers: ov12/tu044 RgDispWpnDat_CreateRestNumStr (capacity; previously restated in src/ov12/rg_disp.h), ov12/tu006 _JobEnemy (capacity 0x00a0c89c/0x00a0c8c4, shotEssence 0x00a0c918) (shared-model-ov12-weapon-essence-20260925)

ov12/tu023 _InitRgShotEssence (0x00a15c9c) initializes and _InitShotCommon reads the prefix every shot kind embeds as `common`; config/header-exports.json exports it to include/ov12/rg_shot.h, where RgHomingShotEssence already embeds it; RgWeaponEssence.shotEssence (ov12/tu027) points at it (shared-model-ov12-weapon-essence-20260925)

ov12/tu023 InitRgNormalShotEssence (0x00a15d28, swc1 0x120) and _CreateRgNormalShot read/write speed at +0x120; exported for ov12/tu006 _JobEnemy, which reads the weapon's shot speed (lwc1 0x120 at 0x00a0c92c) (shared-model-ov12-weapon-essence-20260925)
